subject: Intro: Redwood Inference demo — use case & traffic profile
messages:
From: Sophie Lane <sophie@cleofoods.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Redwood — quick demo request

Hi Karthik,

We signed up for Redwood last week (self-serve) and I wanted to request a short demo to understand how we should configure inference for our product recommendations pipeline. A few quick details to help you: 

- Company: Cleo Foods (direct-to-consumer food brand)
- Use case: real-time personalized product recommendations on mobile and web; reranking for promotional placements
- Typical traffic: 1K–3K inference requests/minute at peak; avg seq length ~120 tokens; occasional batch exports for nightly scoring (~200k items)
- Timeline: pilot for marketing personalization starts mid-April; production by end of Q2 if performance checks out

I attached a small CSV with anonymized request volume by hour and a couple of screenshots of the current recommendation flow. Would appreciate a 30-min call to run through recommended config (models, batching, KV cache) and anticipated latency/cost tradeoffs.

Available slots in my timezone (PDT): Tue/Thu mornings 9:30–11:30am or Wed 2–4pm.

Thanks,
Sophie Lane
Head of Product, Cleo Foods
Sophie Lane | +1 415-555-0127

Attachments: Cleo_Retail_Traffic.csv (CSV), site-map-screens.png (PNG)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie@cleofoods.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — quick demo request

Hi Sophie — great to hear from you, and congrats on the self-serve onboarding. Thanks for the CSV and screenshots — helpful context. A couple quick qualification questions so we make the 30 minutes as useful as possible: 

1) Traffic distribution: the CSV looks like peak evenings for your US customers — is the 1K–3K/minute peak sustained for >10 minutes or more of bursty traffic (e.g., flash sales)?
2) SLA needs: do you have a hard p99 latency target for recommendations (e.g., <100ms)?
3) Data sensitivity: will recommendation inputs include PII or payment data (we ask for cloud/private deployment recommendations)?
4) Integration: are you planning to call Redwood directly from client apps or via server-side aggregator/microservice?

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 2027-03-02 09:30–10:00
- Tue 2027-03-02 10:00–10:30
- Wed 2027-03-03 14:00–14:30

I can cover product-fit and recommended serving patterns. I'll loop in Monica (our solutions AE) on the confirmation so she can prep technical specifics (model selection and batching knobs).

Would any of these times work?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0234

From: Sophie Lane <sophie@cleofoods.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — quick demo request

Thanks Karthik — quick answers below and slot preference.

On Mon, 1 Mar 2027 at 11:05, Karthik Iyer wrote:
> 1) Traffic distribution: the CSV looks like peak evenings for your US customers — is the 1K–3K/minute peak sustained for >10 minutes or more of bursty traffic (e.g., flash sales)?

- Peaks are campaign-driven, typically 20–45 minutes sustained at 2–3K/min when we run promotions. Non-campaign days are ~400–800/min.

> 2) SLA needs: do you have a hard p99 latency target for recommendations (e.g., <100ms)?

- We target p95 <120ms; p99 can be up to 250ms for heavier requests. We're open to guidance on tradeoffs.

> 3) Data sensitivity: will recommendation inputs include PII or payment data

- No payment data. Inputs include customer_id, browsing context, and sometimes hashed email for deduping. Not sensitive PII.

> 4) Integration: are you planning to call Redwood directly from client apps or via server-side aggregator/microservice?

- Server-side aggregator (our recommendation microservice).

Preferred slot: Tue 2027-03-02 10:00–10:30 PDT. Please send a calendar invite.

Looking forward — cheers,
Sophie

Attachments: none in this reply

Perfect — booked Tue 2027-03-02 10:00–10:30 PDT. Invite sent (you should see a calendar event from "Redwood Inference Demo: Cleo Foods"). I've CC'd Monica and Ben so we have the right technical and onboarding presence. 

Monica — quick FYI on the prep: Cleo Foods is targeting mid-April pilot, traffic profile attached in the original thread (2–3k/min sustained during promos, avg seq ~120 tokens). They call from a server-side microservice and do not send PII/payment info. p95 target ~120ms, p99 up to 250ms. Could you pull a short pre-demo checklist (model variants to consider, initial batching and cache suggestions, and any sandbox credentials we should provide)?

Sophie — please let us know if you'd like a short agenda. My plan: 5-min intros, 10-min traffic profile & requirements, 10-min recommended config + Q/A, 5-min next steps (pilot checklist and timeline).

Thanks all — talk soon.

Best,
Karthik
